name: epic-git
description: Fast-starting cross-platform Git client: Neutralino shell + Node/TS backend + TS frontend

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n frontend,backend,app "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run neu:run -- -- --enable-extensions=false --window-enable-inspector=true"
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run neu:build
